reference.note: Viitenumero (national bank reference, SFS check digit). Minted and validated by finland/verkkolasku.js arithmetic; the OUTBOUND issuance builder mints it too via the scheme-keyed referenceSchemes registry (viite base = the allocated invoice number), so a Donna-issued outbound FI invoice carries its viite from day one. Parsed/imported anchors still consume the persisted value (draft.finvoice or draft.invoice.referenceNumber). A reminder in this pack states the viite ({{reference_number}}); an anchor without one rests on the owner as a named gap rather than sending a reference-less FI reminder.

einvoice.note: D3 (defer-but-schedule, 2026-07-24): Finvoice 3.0 XML + PDF attached to email ships now (exists on the FI lane); the operator network (Maventa-class verkkolasku) is the FI-B2B credibility unlock, committed as 'planned' so this manifest's shape is honest before the lane ships. Pull forward if an early FI customer's buyers demand operator delivery.

tax.note: The FI ALV vocabulary predates taxVocabularies.js and routes via FINLAND_ALV_CODING (deliberately absent from the registry's jurisdiction map) — null is the honest marker, not a gap.

payment_rails.note: IBAN + viitenumero is the Finnish payment norm; no pay-link rail is declared (D4, 2026-07-24: pay-links are the US settlement signal — Finland's is the viite). The G11 virtual barcode (virtuaaliviivakoodi) rides the FI invoice PDF, not this manifest.

late_interest.source: Korkolaki 633/1982 § 4 a — viivästyskorko kaupallisissa sopimuksissa: Suomen Pankin puolivuosittain vahvistama viitekorko + 8 prosenttiyksikköä
late_interest.note: D5: the RULE is provenanced here; the numeric half-year reference rate is deliberately NOT carried until it is recorded from Suomen Pankki with its own as_of date. No Phase-1 template states an interest amount or fee — a future interest-bearing reminder requires rate_percent filled with that provenance first, never a computed or remembered number.

constraints: D5 (2026-07-24): dunning is B2B-only, muistutus/maksukehotus tone. No late fees and no interest amounts render in any Phase-1 reminder; late_interest above carries the statutory rule for the later slice that earns them.
Perintalaki 513/1999: consumer collection is regulated (reminder timing, fee caps) — B2C dunning and fee-bearing collection are explicitly out of scope until reviewed.

mandatory_fields.note: reference_number binds the outbound builder to mint a viite per draft (the referenceSchemes registry — bound 2026-07-24, closing the M3 refusal; pack v3). The statutory ALV content (AVL 209 e §) is enforced by the FI lane's buildInvoice/buildFinvoice, not restated here — the finland/ issuance lane keeps serving its existing flows unchanged.

chart_of_accounts.note: The fallback coding menu for a Finnish client with no synced chart of accounts. Before this leg every such client — in every market — was coded against XERO_ACCOUNT_OPTIONS, a Singapore-flavoured list carrying 'CPF payable' and no ALV account at all. 'Suoritettava arvonlisävero' is carried under its established Finnish name because that exact string is the ALV settlement account the FI posting path already resolves; the remaining names are English pending a localized-display-name slice. That deferral is safe BECAUSE each account declares its canonical role: the role is the machine identity, the name is a view, so renaming later is a display change and not a re-coding. Roles, not names, are what the posting paths resolve.

fallback_accounts.name: Payroll withholding and employer health-insurance payable

obligations.note: The statutory duties this pack's market imposes that generate work on their own clock. Enumerated here as pack DATA — nothing under server/donna/finland/ is edited by this leg. The two bound entries below are exactly the two drains the country-named `finland_watches` cron already ran; binding them by name is what lets the cron become jurisdiction-neutral (`statutory_watches`) instead of growing a `uk_watches` sibling. This list is NOT the whole of Finnish statutory bookkeeping duty — it is the set core currently watches; further duties (ALV return periods, ennakkovero, tilinpäätös/annual return) are served today by modules the loop runtime drives, and move onto this leg as they are bound.

items.name: ALV registration threshold watch
items.source: Arvonlisäverolaki 1501/1993 — vähäinen liiketoiminta: a business must register for ALV once its taxable turnover for the accounting period exceeds the small-business threshold, and Donna must raise it with the owner before the boundary is crossed unnoticed
items.note: The numeric threshold is NOT carried here: it lives with the deterministic watch that reads it, provenanced there. This entry declares the DUTY and who imposes it. Direct sibling of the GB pack's gb_vat_registration_threshold — the same duty shape in two markets is the parallel build's evidence that the leg generalises.

items.name: Posting-time scope-drift owner review
items.source: Kirjanpitolaki 1336/1997 — the owner is responsible for the accuracy of the books; where posting detects activity outside the scope Donna was told to keep, the owner must be asked rather than have a treatment assumed on their behalf
items.note: The ask is minted in the posting transaction (portal-visible immediately — the on-owner terminal); this obligation is the daily delivery leg, which cannot ride the posting transaction because it does network I/O. Two-terminal-states: the ask rests on the OWNER, never on us.
